meta.name: Failed to save mod order
meta.title: Deadlock Mod Manager "Failed to Save Mod Order" Fix
meta.description: Getting Failed to save mod order in Deadlock Mod Manager? Close Deadlock, release locked .vpk files and fix folder permissions, then save the load order again.

hero.title: Failed to save mod order
hero.intro: Saving the load order renames your mod files so Deadlock loads them in the new order. When a file is locked or protected, the rename is rolled back and the app shows this error. The message under it tells you why.
hero.errorSource: Deadlock Mod Manager, after saving in Manage Mod Load Order

causes.fileInUse: The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process. (os error 32)
causes.vpkInUse: VPK files are in use and cannot be deleted
causes.shardsFull: All addon shard folders are full

causes.title: Find your message, apply the fix
causes.intro: Read the line under "Failed to save mod order" in the notification and match it below.

gameRunning.fix: Quit Deadlock completely, including from the system tray, then save the order again. If the game already closed, wait a few seconds for the process to exit.

fileInUse.fix: Another program has a .vpk open. Close File Explorer windows showing the addons folder, VPK viewers and archive tools. Antivirus scans can hold files briefly, so retry after a few seconds or add the Deadlock folder to its exclusions.

vpkInUse.fix: Same cause as above: close the game and any program that has the mod files open, then try again.

accessDenied.fix: Windows is blocking changes to the addons folder. Follow the os error 5 guide to clear read-only flags and permission problems.

shardsFull.fix: You have more enabled .vpk files than the game can load. Disable mods you don't use, then save the order again.

steps.restart: Close Deadlock and restart Deadlock Mod Manager.
steps.checkInstalls: Open Mods Library and check every mod finished installing. Remove and reinstall any that look stuck.
steps.saveAgain: Click Change Mods Order again and save.
steps.discord: Still failing? Share the full message and your app version on <discord>Discord</discord>.

why.question: Why does Deadlock Mod Manager fail to save my mod order?
why.answer: Saving the order renames the .vpk files in your addons folder so the game loads them in the new order. It fails when Deadlock is running, when another program has a .vpk open, or when Windows denies access to the folder.

loseMods.question: Do I lose my mods when saving the order fails?
loseMods.answer: No. The app rolls the rename back when a step fails, so your mods stay installed in their previous order. Fix the cause and save again.

whileOpen.question: Can I change the load order while Deadlock is open?
whileOpen.answer: No. The game keeps its .vpk files open while it runs, so close Deadlock first. Changes apply the next time you launch modded.

whatChanges.question: What does mod order actually change?
whatChanges.answer: When two mods replace the same file, only one version can load, and the mod order decides which one. Mods that don't overlap work the same in any order.

downloadBand.title: Drag mods into the order you want
downloadBand.body: Deadlock Mod Manager shows which mods conflict and lets you pick the winner by reordering them.
